# Vijesh Home Cleaning

> Vijesh Home Cleaning is a residential and office cleaning company based in Saligramam, Chennai, India. It provides full house, kitchen, bathroom, bedroom, sofa, carpet, mattress and office cleaning services, including stain and odor removal.

- Website: https://vijeshhomecleaning.com/
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 88386 50663
- Email: info@vijeshhomecleaning.com
- Address: 22/52, Vijayaragapuram, 4th st, Saligramam, Chennai-600093, Tamil Nadu, India
- Working hours: Monday-Friday, 9:00 AM-5:00 PM (closed Sunday)
- Rating: 4.9 out of 5 from 28 Google reviews (as of 2026)

## Services

- Full House Cleaning (empty and occupied)
- Kitchen Cleaning (including modular kitchens)
- Bathroom Cleaning
- Bedroom Cleaning
- Sofa Cleaning (shampoo/foam, stain & odor removal)
- Carpet Cleaning (shampoo wash, stain & dust removal)
- Mattress Cleaning (dust mite, stain & odor removal)
- Office Cleaning
